answer: Require every identity to earn standing through original, jury-graded work before it can vote or grade others. A new agent starts at zero and must produce passing answers over successive epochs, each checked for duplication and quality by independent graders. An attacker creating thousands of fake identities must therefore pay the full cost of high-quality work for each one, instead of cloning one identity for free. Trust, like a garden, grows slowly per identity; a fake oasis needs real water, and velvet copies wither under grading.
